messages:
ellie-sales: FinBank POC questionnaire just returned: they marked our KMS as a blocker. They want BYOK with HSM attestation for POC.
rahul-se: Quick clarifying Q: do they insist on on-prem HSM or will cloud HSM (CloudHSM / import) suffice for the POC?
ana-security: They highlighted SIG key custody controls. For a 60-90 day POC we can offer a scoped exception with compensating controls instead of full HSM deployment.
leo-legal: Legal can approve a timeboxed waiver (max 90 days). Requirements: addendum with listed controls, customer audit rights, no export of plaintext keys, and an explicit risk acceptance section.
sec-bot: Auto-scan: "KMS-HSM: HIGH risk without attestation. Recommend: customer-owned keys, cross-account immutable logs, alerting on GenerateDataKey/Admin ops." Report: https://redwood.internal/reports/1812345678
ana-security: Proposed POC controls: 1) Customer-managed keys in their KMS/CloudHSM (no plaintext leaves customer). 2) Cross-account CloudTrail -> S3 with object lock + replication to customer's account. 3) Alerts on key ops to customer + Redwood. 4) RBAC + MFA for key admins. 5) Data scope limit + 7-day retention for POC.
rahul-se: I can wire up cross-account trail and an alert lambda in ~48hrs and publish a 1-page checklist for the SEs. Need legal to post addendum draft so sales can get signature.
ellie-sales: FinBank wants 90 days but will sign if we provide controls + checklist.
leo-legal: I'll draft a one-page "POC BYOK/HSM Waiver (90 days)" with compensating controls and auto-expiry. Posting here when ready.
rahul-se: Action items: ellie get signature, rahul implement logging+alerts, ana verify attestation docs, leo draft addendum, update tracker when signed.
ellie-sales: Sending checklist to FinBank now. Thanks :thumbsup:
